name: Product Name Presence
description: Medical device label must clearly state the trade or proprietary product name.
remediation_hint: Add the official approved proprietary or device trade name prominently on the label.

name: Manufacturer Name Presence
description: Label must contain the legal manufacturer name and corporate identity.
remediation_hint: Include the registered manufacturer corporate name preceded by 'Manufactured by' or the factory symbol.

name: Expiration Date Presence
description: A clear use-by date / expiration date must be indicated for device stability and patient safety.
remediation_hint: Provide a valid expiration date in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM) format next to the hourglass symbol.

name: Batch / Lot Number Presence
description: Device must bear a batch code or lot number to ensure unit traceability and recall capability.
remediation_hint: Include lot/batch designation adjacent to the ISO [LOT] symbol.

name: Safety Warnings & Precautions
description: Label must bear essential safety warnings, contraindications, or cautionary statements.
remediation_hint: Add required risk warnings, contraindications, or storage hazards.

name: Storage Conditions
description: Any special storage or handling conditions (e.g. temperature limits, keep dry) must be stated.
remediation_hint: State valid storage temperature ranges (e.g., 'Store between 2°C and 8°C').

name: Expiration Date Future Validity
description: Medical device expiration date must be in the future at the time of label verification.
remediation_hint: Ensure expiration date has not elapsed; expired product cannot be distributed.

name: Chronological Date Order
description: Expiration date must be chronologically after the manufacturing date.
remediation_hint: Correct manufacturing or expiration date so that MFG precedes EXP.

standard: FDA 21 CFR Part 830 / EU MDR Article 27
name: UDI Carrier Presence
description: Medical device label must contain a machine-readable UDI barcode carrier (1D or 2D).
remediation_hint: Place a high-contrast GS1-128 or DataMatrix barcode containing DI and PI elements.

name: UDI DI Checksum Validity
description: Device Identifier (GTIN) must strictly satisfy the GS1 Modulo-10 checksum algorithm.
remediation_hint: Recalculate and re-encode the 14-digit GTIN with the correct Modulo-10 check digit.

name: UDI Lot Cross-Match
description: The Lot Number encoded in the UDI barcode must match the human-readable text LOT on the label.
remediation_hint: Synchronize UDI AI(10) with the printed [LOT] text.

name: UDI Expiry Date Cross-Match
description: The Expiry Date encoded in the UDI barcode AI(17) must match printed human-readable EXP text.
remediation_hint: Synchronize UDI AI(17) YYMMDD date with the printed expiration date.

name: Sterile Claim Symbol Verification
description: Devices claiming sterility must display the official ISO 15223-1 STERILE symbol.
remediation_hint: Include the ISO 15223-1 [STERILE] or sterilization method symbol on the label artwork.

name: Single-Use Symbol Verification
description: Single-use devices must display the ISO 15223-1 'Do Not Re-use' (2 in circle with slash) symbol.
remediation_hint: Add the ISO 15223-1 5.4.2 'Do not re-use' symbol adjacent to instructions.

name: Temperature Limit Symbol Verification
description: Devices with temperature restrictions must accompany text with the ISO temperature thermometer symbol.
remediation_hint: Add the ISO 15223-1 5.3.7 thermometer symbol next to temperature limit numbers.

name: CE Conformity Mark
description: Devices marketed in the European Union must bear the CE mark with 4-digit Notified Body ID where required.
remediation_hint: Include the CE logo along with the designated Notified Body 4-digit number.

name: Prescription Only Statement
description: Prescription-only devices must state 'Rx Only' or statutory caution phrase.
remediation_hint: Include 'Rx Only' or 'Caution: Federal law restricts this device to sale by or on the order of a physician'.
